claim: As of 2026-08-28, the official production baseline is React 19.2 (latest listed patch 19.2.7) with Next.js 16.3.3 Active LTS.

claim: The official Next.js 16 upgrade guide directs manual upgrades to latest Next.js, React, and React DOM packages and requires Node.js 20.9+ and TypeScript 5.1+.

claim: Important Next.js 16 upgrade constraints include Turbopack becoming the default and synchronous access to params, searchParams, cookies, headers, and draftMode being removed.
